# Midday alert, Thu Oct 22, 2026 (Research Inc., ~12:30 PM ET)

**AI-hardware guidance shocks; Iran escalation report deepens the selloff.**

- TTMI about −27% (~$74): Q3 beat, but Q4 revenue guide below consensus and leverage up to 2.8x on acquisitions. ([MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-ttm-technologies-nasdaq-ttmi-shares-gap-down-heres-what-happened-2026-10-22/), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/ttm-technologies-shares-tumble-despite-q3-beat-on-soft-q4-view-93CH-4965273))
- NOK about −11% (~$8.21), six-month low: negative FCF, FCF-conversion guide cut to 35–55%, structural supply-cost warning. ([Stocktwits](https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/nok-stock-nokia-ceo-says-supply-squeeze-is-a-structural-cost-increase-not-just-a-shortage/cZxwXVCRBD5))
- Report that the US and Israel are preparing renewed Iran strikes; Brent $112. Nasdaq −2.1%, S&P −1.2% late morning. ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-october-22-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-tesla-meta-112217857.html))

**Desk read (long-only swing):** Add TTMI and NOK to avoid. Semis and airlines stay in avoid. No new longs into the AI-hardware tape.
